visualCharacteristics.purpose: Vollflächige, klickbare Bildkacheln mit Verlauf und zentriertem Titel, Verbrauchsangaben unter der Kachel
visualCharacteristics.image: full tile, rounded corners, bottom gradient
visualCharacteristics.title: centered, overlaid at the bottom
visualCharacteristics.extras: small WLTP disclaimer below the tile

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image (with alt); cell 2: heading + link (the whole tile becomes the link); cell 3: consumption/emission disclaimer (rich text)

reuseGuidance: Use for clickable tool/entry tiles where the title sits on top of the image and the whole tile links to a target.
